investigations.question: What kills the pilot inside the x=2550-6050 gap, what holds it at/below x~9925 for 280s, and what does each death cost in replay seconds? Stored evidence has no death cause/events, no input history, no position/stall trace, no hazard-phase data, and no gameplay frames; mistimed encounters, unfair hotspots, and policy defects are all live.
investigations.smallestNextStep: Bounded rerun with death events (hazard id/cause/phase at each hotspot), input history, a position/stall trace, checkpoint replay time, and retained gameplay frames of the desert-gap encounters including the drone beat at x=4300 and telegraph visibility in the frames before each death; repeat across fresh starts/phases. Only if a cluster repeats in captured play may an encounter edit be proposed.

fixes.smallestFix: Add a checkpoint so no gap over 2500px is without one, clear of beam timing and patrol lanes.
fixes.recheck: Re-run the full critic: no checkpoint gap over 2500px may remain, and the rerun must retain checkpoint replay time after death in the repaired stretch showing a lower seconds-cost than the retained run.
fixes.limitations: Code-measured from checkpoint data, but replay time in seconds is not retained, so the seconds-cost of the gap is estimated from distance until INV-1 measures it.
fixes.alternativeCause: Deliberate pacing: a long checkpoint-free stretch may be intended difficulty -- but 3500px exceeds the 2500px rule, so the build report would need to justify the exception, and none is on record.
